# Harness signature sources

One row per recognized product: the identity evidence the signature relies on, the configuration it reads, and what stays out of reach. Each product has fixtures in `src/harness/tests.rs`. Checked against installs and docs on 2026-11-22. "Local install" means the layout was observed on a real installation. "Docs/source" means it was taken from official documentation or released source without a local install.

Shared resources never establish identity for any product. These include `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `SOUL.md`, `.agents/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.gemini/config/`, `.cursor/` or `.claude/` content imported by another harness, plugin folders, and `CLAUDE_*` variables. ZCode, WorkBuddy, Grok and Cursor hooks all set `CLAUDE_*`, and Codex shell policies can inject them.

| Product | Identity evidence | Config read (allowlisted keys only) | Not observable / caveats | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `~/.local/share/claude/versions/<v>`, npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code`, bundle `com.anthropic.claude-code`, env `CLAUDECODE=1` (IDE terminals set it too) | `settings.json` (user, project, local): `model`, `effortLevel`, `enabledPlugins`, `permissions.defaultMode`/`deny`; `.claude.json` beside the root: `mcpServers`, `projects[<dir>].{mcpServers,hasTrustDialogAccepted,disabledMcpjsonServers}`; `.mcp.json`; `skills/`, `agents/`; `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` | Provider selection via environment; managed settings; live `/model` choice | Local install 2.1.330; code.claude.com/docs/en/settings, env-vars |
| Codex CLI | `~/.codex/packages/standalone/`, npm `@openai/codex`, env `CODEX_THREAD_ID`/`CODEX_SANDBOX` | `config.toml`: `model`, `model_provider`, `model_reasoning_effort`, `profile` → `profiles.<p>` or `<p>.config.toml`, `mcp_servers.*.enabled`, `plugins`, `agents.<name>`, `sandbox_mode`, `approval_policy`, `projects.<dir>.trust_level`; project `.codex/config.toml` (trusted only); `skills/`, `agents/*.toml`; `CODEX_HOME` | Session `--model`/`-c` overrides, cloud-managed defaults | Local install 0.169.0; developers.openai.com/codex/config-basic, config-reference; codex-rs spawn.rs |
| Gemini CLI | npm `@google/gemini-cli`, Homebrew `gemini-cli`, env `GEMINI_CLI=1` | `settings.json` (user, project): `model.name`, `mcpServers`, `general.defaultApprovalMode`, `tools.sandbox`; `trustedFolders.json`; `skills/`, `agents/`, `extensions/`; `GEMINI_CLI_HOME`, `GEMINI_CLI_TRUSTED_FOLDERS_PATH`, `GEMINI_MODEL` | The `security.folderTrust.enabled` default conflicts between doc pages, so a missing entry is reported as unverified | Docs/source: geminicli.com/docs/reference/configuration, google-gemini/gemini-cli |
| Antigravity | Bundle `com.google.antigravity`, `Antigravity.app`, `agy`; config markers `~/.gemini/antigravity*` | `antigravity-cli/settings.json`: `model`, `modelProvider`, `agentMode`, `toolPermission`, `permissions.deny`, `trustedWorkspaces`; `config/mcp_config.json` (`disabled`); `.agents/mcp_config.json`; `config/skills`, `antigravity-cli/skills`, `config/agents`, `config/plugins` | Thinking level (set in-session), child-process variables, untrusted-workspace semantics | Docs: antigravity.google/docs (customization-discovery, settings, mcp, skills, subagents); Homebrew cask |
| Kimi Code | `~/.kimi-code/bin/`, npm `@moonshot-ai/kimi-code`, env `KIMI_CODE_SESSION_ID` (tool shells); `kimi acp` is the ACP surface | `config.toml`: `default_model` → `models.<alias>.{provider,model}`, `thinking.{enabled,effort}`, `default_permission_mode`; `mcp.json` (`enabled`); `skills/`, `agents/`; `updates/install.json` version; `KIMI_CODE_HOME` | Workspace trust state is undocumented, so project config is reported as unverified | Local install 2.5.2; kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli |
| Kimi CLI (legacy) | `uv/tools/kimi-cli/`, `site-packages/kimi_cli/`, `kimi-cli`; root `~/.kimi` (`KIMI_SHARE_DIR`) | `config.toml` `default_model` alias, `default_thinking`, `default_yolo`; `mcp.json`; `.migrated-to-kimi-code` marker | `Kimi.app` (`com.moonshot.kimichat`) is the chat app, not Kimi Code | Local install 1.47.0 |
| Grok Build | `~/.grok/downloads/grok-<v>-<os>`, `~/.grok/bin/`; `agent` is a second name for the same binary, and `agent stdio` is ACP | `config.toml`: `models.default`, `models.default_reasoning_effort`, `mcp_servers`, `disabled_mcp_servers`, `ui.permission_mode`, `permission.deny`; project `.grok/config.toml`; `trusted_folders.toml`; `skills/`, `agents/`, `plugins/`; `.metadata_version`; `GROK_HOME` | `Grok Bot.app` is `com.anysphere.sand` and is not treated as Grok Build. Imported Claude/Cursor resources are not evidence for those products. | Local install 1.0.77 and bundled docs `~/.grok/docs/user-guide` |
| WorkBuddy | Bundle `com.tencent.workbuddy.mac` (Electron executable), `~/.workbuddy/binaries/` | `settings.json` `enabledPlugins`; `mcp.json`; project `.workbuddy/mcp.json`; `skills/`; `last-launch.json` version; `WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR` | Model selection is not in local config files. Connector and cloud state are not read. `~/.codebuddy` belongs to CodeBuddy. | Local install 5.11.3; bundled `cli/product.json`; workbuddy.ai MCP guide |
| DeepSeek Harness | npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh`, env `DSH_SESSION_ID` (model shell calls); `dsh acp`/`web`/`sdk` | `cordis.patch.yml`: plugin entries `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model` (`provider`, `model`, `reasoningEffort`) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (`serverName`); `skills/`, `profiles/`; `DSH_HOME` | Profile and bundle layers are not resolved. Desktop bundle ID is unverified, so it is not used. A bare `dsh` binary is not identity. | Docs/source: github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.1) |
| Cursor | `~/.local/share/cursor-agent/versions/` (CLI), bundles `com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92` and `co.anysphere.cursor.nightly` (IDE), env `CURSOR_AGENT`; `agent acp` | `cli-config.json`: `model` (strings only), `approvalMode`, `sandbox.mode`, `permissions.deny`; `.cursor/cli.json`; `mcp.json` (user, project); `skills/`, `agents/`, `plugins/local`; `CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR` | IDE model choice and MCP toggles are kept in editor state. Cloud agents are not visible. `CURSOR_TRACE_ID` appears in every Cursor terminal, so it is not used. | Docs: cursor.com/docs (cli configuration, mcp, skills, subagents, terminal, deployment-patterns) |
| ZCode | `~/.zcode/runtime/` (`zcode-runtime` package), `zcode`, bundles `dev.zcode.app[.preview]`, env `ZCODE_SESSION_ID` | `v2/provider_config.json` `config.defaultModelSelection.{providerId,modelId}` (or `ZCODE_PERSONAL_PROVIDER_CONFIG_FILE`); `cli/config.json` `mcp.servers`, `plugins.enabledPlugins`, `permission.{mode,disallowedTools}`; `zcode.json`, `.zcode/config.json`; `skills/`; `ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR` | Reasoning options are model-specific. The session database is never read. Not Zed (`dev.zed.Zed`). | Docs/source: github.com/zai-org/ZCode v3.18.2 |
| Pi | npm `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` (or legacy `@mariozechner/…`), `~/.pi/agent/install/`, env `PI_CODING_AGENT=true`/`AI_AGENT=pi` | `settings.json` (user, project): `defaultProvider`, `defaultModel`, `defaultThinkingLevel`, `packages`, `extensions`, `defaultProjectTrust`; `mcp.json`; `trust.json` (closest ancestor wins); `skills/`, `extensions/`, `agents/`; `install/current-version`; `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` | Extensions can register tools at runtime. `models.json` and `auth.json` are never read. | Local install 1.6.0 with bundled docs |
| Hermes Agent | Bundled interpreter `~/.hermes/tools/python-*`, `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/`, `site-packages/hermes_cli/`, bundles `com.nousresearch.hermes*`, env `HERMES_SESSION_ID`/`HERMES_AGENT=true`; `gateway`/`serve`/`acp` | `config.yaml`: `model.{default,provider}`, `agent.reasoning_effort`, `mcp_servers` (`enabled`), `plugins.enabled`, `approvals.mode`, `terminal.backend`, `skills.trusted_project_dirs`; `skills/<category>/<name>`; `desktop-ssh/` presence; `install-stamp.json`; `HERMES_HOME`, `active_profile` | Remote SSH gateways and terminal backends run on other machines. `Hermes.app` (`com.nousresearch.hermes.setup`) is only the installer. | Local install 0.23.3 with bundled docs |
| OpenCode | `opencode`/`opencode2`, npm `opencode-ai` or `@opencode/cli`, bundles `ai.opencode.desktop[.beta]`, env `OPENCODE=1` (V1) | `opencode.json[c]` (global, project, `.opencode/`): `model`, `agent`/`agents`, `plugin`/`plugins`, MCP `mcp.<name>` (V1, `enabled`) or `mcp.servers.<name>` (V2, `disabled`); `skills/`, `agents/`, `plugins/` | No project trust. `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` and remote org config are not read. A plugins folder alone is not evidence. | Docs/source: opencode.ai/docs/config (V2), anomalyco/opencode v1.19.6 |
| OpenClaw | `openclaw`, npm `openclaw`, bundle `ai.openclaw.mac`, env `OPENCLAW_SHELL`/`OPENCLAW_CLI=1`; `gateway`/`acp`/`tui`/`mcp` | `openclaw.json` (JSON5) or `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`: `agents.defaults.model[.primary]`, `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault`, `agents.entries`, `mcp.servers` (`enabled`), `plugins.entries`, `tools.{deny,profile}`, `agents.defaults.sandbox.mode`; `skills/`, `workspace/skills`, `extensions/`; `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, `OPENCLAW_HOME`, `OPENCLAW_PROFILE` | Gateway sessions, auth profiles and SQLite state are never read | Docs/source: docs.openclaw.ai, openclaw/openclaw |

Recognition-only rows use the same mechanism: Qwen Code (`@qwen-code/qwen-code`, `~/.qwen`), GitHub Copilot CLI (`@github/copilot`, `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`), Amp (`@ampcode/cli`, `~/.config/amp/settings.json` `amp.mcpServers`) and Aider (`aider-chat`, `~/.aider.conf.yml`). Goose and Windsurf are not recognized. Goose's `goose` name collides with an unrelated migration tool, and Windsurf's identity could not be verified locally.
